HOW TO PLAY

HOLD THE CORNER.

Team Deathmatch: each enemy defeat gives your crew one point. First to 30 kills wins. Turf War: capture point A, hold it for team points, and keep the other crew out. Kills open routes; holding turf wins the match. First to 150, or the higher score after three minutes, wins.

150 POINTSFirst crew there wins

On a phone: left pad to move, right area to look, and hold FIRE to shoot. Tap AIM, RUN, or CROUCH to toggle them. JUMP, RELOAD, and GUN are always within reach. Landscape gives you more room.

    WHAT'S NEWv0.4.1 · October 15, 2026

    Phone controls. Faster first match.

    The block is easier to jump into. Here is what has changed:

    1. Play on your phone

      Move with the left pad, drag to look, and hold FIRE. Jump, reload, switch guns, aim, sprint, and crouch with touch buttons.

    2. One click to Easy bots

      Play now starts Team Deathmatch with Easy bots. Change the mode or difficulty whenever you are ready.

    3. Learn while you play

      Your first round guides you through moving, looking, and firing, with feedback for your first hit and takedown.

    4. Bring your crew

      Choose Team Deathmatch or Turf War, try three bot difficulties, or invite friends and play another round together.

    This update stays closed for today. A new update may appear again.
